title: Google's New AI Costs $2 Now. $4 Later.
description:
Google's Gemini 4 Argon launches at an introductory $2 / $10 per million tokens - Google says it rises to $4 / $20 later. Access starts with vetted cyber defenders; wider rollout has no date yet. #Shorts #ai #aitools
